Hyderabad Ganesh procession sees Hindu-Muslim collaboration and one death

During the Ganesh festival in Hyderabad, Hindu and Muslim communities collaborated on mandapams (temporary structures for idols). One youth died under suspicious circumstances during a Ganesh procession. The Siasat Daily reported that Ganesh pandals were to be geo-tagged.
